entities.name: Roussel de Bailleul
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Roussel de Bailleul, known in Greek as Ourselios, and by the nickname Phrangopoulos, was a Norman adventurer who travelled to Byzantium and was a soldier under the Emperor Romanos IV Diogenes.
